Explain photosynthesis: Plants use sunlight water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and oxygen in chloroplasts
Plants use sunlight water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and oxygen in chloroplasts
Photosynthesis is how green plants turn light energy into chemical energy stored as sugar
It is the process where leaves capture light to build food for the plant using CO2 and H2O
Chlorophyll absorbs light and the plant makes sugar while releasing oxygen as a byproduct
